text:
erin: Quick ask  product marketing needs a 'field postcard' one-pager + landing snippet for the deploy-mode launch (hosted / dedicated / private). This should be ultra-short for SDRs and an A/B copy for the webinar signup.

raj: Got it. Suggest sections: 1-line headline, 3-line value prop, 1-row decision matrix, two micro-benchmarks, security/ SLA bullets, engineer quickbox, CTA. Keep language punchy.

tess: For the benchmark tiles I can surface numbers from the last bench run. Draft numbers for copy only: "p50 gen latency: ~75ms (Dedicated, 512 ctx)", "p95 tail during hosted burst: ~320ms". Cost: hosted baseline ~$0.16 / 1k tokens; optimized stack (dedicated + quant + batching) ~$0.042 / 1k tokens. Add small "approx" footnote.

erin: Nice. Webinar hooks (short): "Stop inference surprises: pick the right deploy mode" and "SLA-driven serving at lower cost". Landing snippet: headline, 3 bullets (security, predictability, unit-economics), two benchmark microtiles, CTA button.

sam: For inbound routing we must be deterministic. Field asked for instant routing on security or private signals so AE can respond immediately. Proposed rules (Intercom / HubSpot):

```
- tag=security-priority if body contains: FedRAMP, SOC2, HIPAA, PCI
- tag=private-interest if body contains: on-prem, air-gapped, "no-cloud", VPC
- set=enterprise_signal if ARR_est >= 100000 or company_size >= 1500
- route_to=AE_queue if tag=security-priority OR tag=private-interest OR enterprise_signal==true
- fallback=SDR_queue
- webhook: POST to /eng-solutions with lead + transcript for security hits
```

raj: Good. Also add a tiny lead_funnel script for SDRs to triage security leads: 1) confirm compliance need, 2) request timeline & expected data residency, 3) assign AE + solutions, 4) offer a pilot slot.

tess: Layout notes: two microtiles side-by-side (latency | cost) with tiny footnote text. Include a 1-liner ops quote: "Dedicated removed billing surprises and tightened tail latency"  -Pilot: Meridian Health.

erin: Add FAQ micro-bullets: "How do SLAs differ?" (hosted: shared; dedicated: contract; private: custom isolation + optional on-prem SLA) and "Can we rollback?" (yes  automatic variant fallback + canary). Keep it one page.

sam: I'll stage routing rules and run smoke tests. tagging @routing-bot to push. Also ask: do we want a variant of the one-pager focused on compliance-heavy buyers (shorter headline + more security copy)?

erin: Yes, create two variants: general field + compliance-focused. Swap the top 3 bullets (compliance, network isolation, KMS) for the compliance one. Keep benchmarks identical.

routing-bot: routing rules deployed to staging (rs-2024-12-11-02). Smoke tests in progress.

routing-bot: smoke tests passed (6/6). Sample payloads properly tagged and routed to AE_queue.

erin: Great work. Tess, can you drop the PDF + a single-line HTML snippet for the landing tile in this thread when ready? Raj, please add the microbench notes as a footnote indicating workload variance. Target publish: next Tue.

raj: Will do. Adding confidence ranges and sample prompt used (chat 64 tokens) to the microbench footnote.

tess: Drafts incoming in 45m. I'll post design previews and two copy variants. :sparkles: 

erin: Thanks team  will schedule a 20-min review tomorrow 9:30am PT. Don't forget to include eng-oncall contact and a one-liner about aggressive fallback routing in the ops section. :rocket:
